text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —...Ghaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ramonu...!! You're... you're...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu... —Thank you for looking up to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I— can reach greater 
heights.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha...! Haaahh...—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Emerging victorious from the fiercely 
contested Queen Elizabeth II Cup is none 
other than... Mejiro Ramonu...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu!! In both name and deed! The 
queen of a new era has been born...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Haah... Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I mustn't... I shouldn't laugh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"For now, show some reverence. Yes, 
'gracefully'..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Please, give a round of 
applause!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
At the intense spirit of the runners. At 
their all-out fighting will...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—From the queen, with love. Allow me to 
grant you my applause.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I knew. Yeah, I realized it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The moon revolves around the Earth, after 
all.

Following her commanding victory at the 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup, Mejiro Ramonu 
gathered the swarming reporters and held a 
press conference.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
First off, congratulations on winning the 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup! Man, that was 
truly a magnificent run...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Coming up after this is the Japan Cup, 
where she'll face off against Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
It's a tight turnaround for adjustments, 
but how do you plan to compete against a 
Classic Triple Crown Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Just like always.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I simply love them. Single-mindedly, 
devotedly...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—I dearly hope you will let me be 
reflected in those eyes of yours.

The one who suddenly appeared was Symboli 
Rudolf. What's more, she was wearing her 
racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You're late.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. It took some time to make 
the adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Increasing training intensity without 
lowering the workload is a very difficult 
task.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To compete against CB... and against you, 
a half-baked preparation simply won't 
stand a chance.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
...Huh! Y-You don't mean... it can't 
be...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Everyone. I apologize for keeping you on 
edge while all those wild rumors were 
flying about.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, at long last, the time for the 
announcement has come.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—I, the 'Emperor' Symboli Rudolf, shall 
also participate in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Ooooooh~~!!

Mejiro Ramonu, Mr. C.B., and—Symboli 
Rudolf. The dream showdown between these 
three is finally happening...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...If it makes you that happy, I 
should've announced it sooner."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A fiercely talented roster of powerful Uma 
Musume gathers for this year's Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I sincerely hope the members of the press 
will do their utmost to hype up this 
festival.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Um... May I take a photo of you two!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "I don't mind. Very well, Ramonu."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That would make great advertising, 
wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Very well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Please, feel free to take pictures. May 
everyone's passion soar to new heights—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Ahaha! Looks like Rudolph finally caved!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Still... this press conference is 
unbelievable. It's like they think this is 
just a two-horse race.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
We need to teach them. Who it is that 
truly directs this race!

The morning after Symboli Rudolf's 
announcement that she would enter the 
race...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on the Way to School A
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, who do you think is going to win 
the Japan Cup? My money is totally on 
President Rudolf!”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on the Way to School B
text_block_list.text:
You totally don't get it~ It has to be Mr. 
C.B.-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on the Way to School C
text_block_list.text:
No way, it's definitely Lady Mejiro 
Ramonu! Wanna play rock-paper-scissors for 
it!?

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Still, it will undoubtedly go down in 
history as a legendary race. Has there 
ever been a race quite like this before?

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you wished for it, you wouldn't 
normally get to see it. I'm so glad to be 
alive in this era!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu-san is truly incredible... ...I 
have to keep doing my best too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
"I'll cherish both this longing and this 
jealousy... so I can finally reach where 
she is!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I see. You're really that fired up about 
it."
choice_data_list:
Yeah, it's all anyone's talking about with 
the Japan Cup!

Yeah, everyone's talking about the Japan 
Cup!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes...
choice_data_list:
Rudolf and Mr. C.B. are both fired up and 
ready to go

Rudolf and Mr. C.B. are both totally fired 
up!

text_block_list.text:
I also saw the two of them training; they 
were pushing themselves quite hard and 
seem to be approaching peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What could this be about, I wonder?

The pieces necessary to manifest the 
supreme race that Mejiro Ramonu seeks are 
falling into place. All that remains is 
for her to attain perfection herself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What a boring question to ask.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I am always filled with a deep love for 
racing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
And yet, who could possibly make me 
submit?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: No, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Speed, luck, and strength... are mere 
accessories to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —I shall demonstrate a flawless victory.

"The final objective race— the Japan 
Cup... is right around the corner."
